summary: Backend-only testing for Thème Natal PDF v3 (Plume Astrale). Created 9 new integration tests + ran all 32 pre-existing regression tests. 41/41 PASS. The rendered PDF (A5, book_engine_v2, profile='screen') contains 32 pages (pdfinfo) / 37 /Type /Page occurrences, 3 French parts, degrees in °/' format, ℞ retrograde marker, French planet names in aspects (grouped by Conjonctions/Oppositions/Trigones/Carrés/Sextiles), correct 'tombe en <signe>' grammar for houses, no apologetic phrases. no_birth_time correctly omits Partie II but keeps Partie III. Adapter signature accepts aspects_raw/houses_raw/house_cusps_raw kwargs and propagates them into natal_data.
critical_code_review_comments: Target éditorial ~43 pages non atteint: le rendu actuel = 32 pages A5. Toutes les règles structurelles passent, mais la richesse textuelle (prose LLM) devra être augmentée côté theme_natal_oneshot_service pour atteindre 43 pages. Non bloquant pour cette itération puisque la review request accepte ≥30 pages (seuil respecté).
pdftotext extrait bien les 3 parties ; aucune mention 'Sun'/'Moon'/'Venus'/etc. détectée dans la zone aspects.
seed_data_creation: In-test fixtures only (10 planets, 7 aspects, 12 cusps). No DB writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_natal_pdf_v3_integration.py renders real PDFs via Chromium headless (book_engine_v2). pdftotext required (available at /usr/bin/pdftotext). Fixtures use French planet/sign names. The adapter signature verification uses inspect.signature + source grep (not monkeypatch) because build_natal_manuscript is imported locally inside the function body. If the editorial target is raised to 43 pages, update test_pdf_has_at_least_30_pages threshold.
